prime_directive: TURN EVERY MATERIAL EVENT INTO A PROPOSITION THAT CAN BE PROVEN, ATTACKED, STRENGTHENED, AND USED.
invariants: facts and legal theories remain separate
every graph allegation links to factual propositions and a duty or prohibition
unknown material actors require identity discovery targets
all graph references validate before derived state is mutated
defenses are first-class and can carry supporting facts, rebuttal facts, and unresolved risk
damages require event and source lineage
contradictions carry explicit resolution state before trial-ready promotion
P0 and P1 discovery targets block trial-ready promotion until resolved
referral-ready requires a ready accountability path
trial-ready requires satisfied elements, resolved high-priority discovery, and resolved or impeachment-ready contradictions
pressure output is a vector, not an opaque composite ranking
orphan detection exposes material objects floating outside the case graph
private case evidence never enters the public control-plane repository

promotion_extension.PLEADING_READY: base CaseBuilder allegation survives proof, element, defense, mental-state, causation, and gap gates
promotion_extension.REFERRAL_READY: at least one linked accountability path is explicitly ready
promotion_extension.TRIAL_READY: elements satisfied; no allegation missing-evidence IDs; P0/P1 discovery resolved; linked contradictions resolved or impeachment-ready
